description: This file contains functions and definitions related to quantization of TorchScript models in PyTorch, including scripting configuration, model fusion, preparation, conversion, and quantization routines for static and dynamic quantization, as well as on-device quantization for TorchScript models.

methods.name: _check_is_script_module(model)
methods.description: Checks if the provided model is a TorchScript ScriptModule. Raises an error if not.

methods.name: _check_forward_method(model)
methods.description: Checks if the ScriptModule has a forward method. Raises an error if not.

methods.name: script_qconfig(qconfig)
methods.description: Creates a QConfig object with scripted activation and weight observers.

methods.name: script_qconfig_dict(qconfig_dict)
methods.description: Applies script_qconfig to each non-None entry in a qconfig dictionary.

methods.name: fuse_conv_bn_jit(model, inplace=False)
methods.description: Fuses convolution and batch norm modules in a ScriptModule for evaluation only.

methods.name: _prepare_jit(model, qconfig_dict, inplace=False, quant_type=QuantType.STATIC)
methods.description: Prepares a scripted model for static quantization by inserting observers and folding conv-bn modules.

methods.name: _prepare_ondevice_jit( model, qconfig_dict, method_name="forward", inplace=False, quant_type=QuantType.STATIC, )
methods.description: Prepares a scripted model for on-device quantization, including inline inlining and observer insertion.

methods.name: prepare_jit(model, qconfig_dict, inplace=False)
methods.description: Public API to prepare a scripted model for static quantization.

methods.name: prepare_dynamic_jit(model, qconfig_dict, inplace=False)
methods.description: Public API to prepare a scripted model for dynamic quantization.

methods.name: _prepare_ondevice_dynamic_jit( model, qconfig_dict, method_name="forward", inplace=False )
methods.description: Prepares a scripted model for on-device dynamic quantization.

methods.name: _convert_jit( model, inplace=False, debug=False, quant_type=QuantType.STATIC, preserved_attrs=None )
methods.description: Converts a scripted model to its quantized version by inserting quantization/dequantization operators.

methods.name: _convert_ondevice_jit( model, method_name, inplace=False, debug=False, quant_type=QuantType.STATIC )
methods.description: Converts a scripted model for on-device inference with quantized weights.

methods.name: convert_jit(model, inplace=False, debug=False, preserved_attrs=None)
methods.description: Public API to convert a scripted model to its static quantized version.

methods.name: convert_dynamic_jit(model, inplace=False, debug=False, preserved_attrs=None)
methods.description: Public API to convert a scripted model for dynamic quantization.

methods.name: _quantize_ondevice_dynamic_jit( model, qconfig_dict, method_name="forward", inplace=False )
methods.description: Prepares and converts a scripted model for on-device dynamic quantization.

methods.name: _quantize_jit( model, qconfig_dict, run_fn=None, run_args=None, inplace=False, debug=False, quant_type=QuantType.STATIC, )
methods.description: Performs post-training static quantization on a scripted model, including calibration.

methods.name: quantize_jit(model, qconfig_dict, run_fn, run_args, inplace=False, debug=False)
methods.description: High-level API to perform full static quantization pipeline on a scripted model.

methods.name: quantize_dynamic_jit(model, qconfig_dict, inplace=False, debug=False)
methods.description: High-level API to perform full dynamic quantization pipeline on a scripted model.

methods.name: _quantize_ondevice_dynamic_jit
methods.description: Helper for preparing and converting on-device dynamic quantization.

methods.name: _convert_ondevice_dynamic_jit(model, method_name, inplace=False, debug=False)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: _quantize_ondevice_dynamic_jit_impl( model, qconfig_dict, method_name, inplace=False )
methods.description: unavailable
